audit.why: Difficulty EVEN at 5.5/10 matches the 50.8% win rate over 3169 games. Early is Ahri's (Orb of Deception 970 range on flat 7s vs Aurora's Q at 900 on 9/8.5/8/7.5/7); mid and side lane favour Aurora once Between Worlds is up.

Spikes are right: level 3 completes the Q-E-Q pattern, level 6 gives both ults (Between Worlds 140/120/100 vs Spirit Rush 140/120/100, three dashes), first item makes the rotation lethal in a Charm gap, late Between Worlds gives repositioning Ahri lacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction (Charm stopping movement abilities, and Orb of Deception's true-damage return) is stated, but the Essence Theft sustain interaction had no Grievous Wounds answer anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's own Charm text says it instantly stops movement abilities, so Across the Veil (W, 22/21/20/19/18s) dies mid-hop to it — this is the whole matchup. Orb of Deception returns as true damage, so MR is not the answer. Essence Theft heals every 9 minions and on every takedown, which chip damage alone cannot outpace.
audit.corrected: breakdown.feeding now names Oblivion Orb as the anti-heal answer to Essence Theft.
